inputs.text: The Supreme Court, state government, and Calcutta High Court are clearly coordinating to keep those tribunals non-operational in West Bengal, with details still pending and only vague talks about locations going on. The software for challenges is supposedly ready but means nothing without any functioning setup, so it's just theater. Meanwhile they've deleted over 58 lakh names from the electoral rolls in that revision exercise. This is textbook elite manipulation to quietly purge voters and make sure there's no real way to push back or restore them.
